name: Operator Reno
teaser: Operator Reno is a new (very light) trader made by Based Cosmo.
description_html:
Operator Reno is a new (very light) trader made by Based Cosmo.

Reno It is a mod I made to introduce myself to making traders. He has some basic, all-around trades, and generally sells whatever he finds in Tarkov. He used to be a Raider but now he sells whatever his messengers bring in from other traders. He often works with Fence and Prapor, with him often talking about a package he needs to receive from Prapor. His assorts (Level 1-2 in the image) are often barter-type trades because he also has a hideout to run. He is often secretive about what his upper-echelon lackeys have access to, trade-wise and work-wise. He seems like he is preparing a quest for you, in the future, as he often mumbles about
“Them damn Scavengers in the factory”.

Right now, he has four loyalty levels, with mostly barter offers or trades with random items. Levels one and two have the most items, with three and four being more conservative with their item selection. Eventually, he will get expanded upon and updated with a quest or two, at least that’s my goal. For now, enjoy what I have already made. Cheers!
